system.description: When you redirect an attack to a minion using the Bodyguard I Talent, that minion can make an immediate melee or ranged attack against your attacker, if the attacker is within Range. Additionally, the bonus provided by the Bodyguard II Talent increases to your full Class Level.

prerequisite.text: Attract Minion talent, Bodyguard I talent, and Bodyguard II talent
